name: Manufacturer / packer / importer name
requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity must declare the name of the manufacturer. Where the manufacturer is not the packer, both names must appear. For an imported package, the importer's name must appear.

name: Complete address of manufacturer / packer / importer
requirement: The declaration of the manufacturer, packer or importer must include a complete address, not only a name.

name: Common or generic name of the commodity
requirement: The package must state the common or generic name of the commodity it contains — i.e. what the product actually is, not only its brand name.

name: Net quantity declaration
requirement: The package must declare the net quantity in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, or the number of commodities where the commodity is sold by number.

name: Month and year of manufacture / pre-packing / import
requirement: The package must declare the month and the year in which the commodity was manufactured, pre-packed or imported.

name: Retail sale price (MRP)
requirement: The package must declare the retail sale price of the package.

name: Consumer care details
requirement: The package must declare the details of the person or office that a consumer can contact with a complaint about the commodity.

name: MRP declared as inclusive of all taxes
requirement: The retail sale price must be declared in the form 'Maximum retail price Rs ... inclusive of all taxes'. A bare price without the tax-inclusive wording does not satisfy the prescribed form.

name: Net quantity uses a standard unit symbol
requirement: Net quantity must use the standard units and symbols of the metric system (for example 'g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l'). Non-standard abbreviations such as 'gms', 'gm' or 'ltr' are not the prescribed symbols.

name: Date declaration is a readable month and year
requirement: The date declaration must identify a month and a year (for example '06/2026' or 'JUN 2026'). A year alone, or an impossible month, does not satisfy the requirement.

name: Consumer care includes a phone number or email
requirement: Consumer care details must give a usable contact route — a telephone number or an email address — not only a name or department.

name: Country of origin on imported packages
requirement: A package containing an imported commodity must declare the country of origin. This check only applies when the label identifies an importer.

name: Height and size of letters and numerals
requirement: Declarations must be printed at or above the prescribed minimum height, which depends on the area of the principal display panel and the net quantity. This is a physical measurement in millimetres.

name: Principal display panel and prominence of declarations
requirement: Declarations must appear on the principal display panel, grouped together and conspicuous against the background. Verifying this needs the physical package, since one photograph shows only part of it.

name: Permitted (standard) pack size
requirement: Certain commodities may only be packed in the standard quantities listed in the Second Schedule. Confirming this needs the commodity to be classified against that schedule.
